target.title: fix(agents): reject malformed bundle LSP frames when content length is invalid
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where bundle LSP startup could accept a malformed `Content-Length` frame from an LSP server and initialize tools from a response that was not valid LSP framing.

## Why This Change Was Made

The bundle LSP stdout parser now accepts exactly one case-insensitive `Content-Length` header with a decimal-only value before reading a JSON-RPC body. Malformed or duplicate `Content-Length` headers fail the LSP session at the bundle LSP runtime boundary without changing LSP tool schemas, bundle discovery, process launch, config, or valid lowercase header behavior.

## User Impact

Users with bundle-provided LSP tools no longer get hover, definition, or references tools materialized from malformed LSP frames, while valid LSP servers that use lowercase `content-length` headers continue to initialize normally.

## Evidence

- Claim proved: current head $head accepts a valid case-insensitive content-length frame from a real spawned LSP subprocess, materializes bundle LSP tools, and fail-closes a real spawned subprocess that sends a malformed Content-Length startup frame before any tools or sessions are exposed.
- Commands / artifacts:
  - 
ode --import tsx <temp proof harness>: imports src/agents/agent-bundle-lsp-runtime.ts, creates temporary Claude bundle .lsp.json fixtures, and lets the production bundle LSP runtime spawn real Node LSP server subprocesses over stdio.
  - 
ode scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/agent-bundle-lsp-runtime.test.ts
  - .
ode_modules\.bin\oxfmt.cmd --check --threads=1 src/agents/agent-bundle-lsp-runtime.ts src/agents/agent-bundle-lsp-runtime.test.ts
  - git diff --check HEAD~1..HEAD
  - python .agents\skills\autoreview\scripts\autoreview --mode commit --commit HEAD --model gpt-5.6-terra --thinking low --no-web-search --codex-speed fast
- Real spawned LSP subprocess transcript, with only local temp paths redacted:

`	ext
[bundle-lsp] failed to start server "malformedcase" (<node> <temp>/proof-lsp-server.mjs malformed <temp>/malformedcase.log): Error: Malformed LSP Content-Length header
head=61bd6699570744d6e11f087db8365f8411e8045f
valid.caseInsensitiveHeader=accepted
valid.sessions=["validcase"]
valid.tools=["lsp_definition_validcase","lsp_hover_validcase","lsp_references_validcase"]
valid.processExitedAfterDispose=true
valid.serverLog=["valid.pid=<pid>","valid.received=initialize#1","valid.sentHeader=content-length:125"]
malformed.invalidContentLength=fail-closed
malformed.sessions=[]
malformed.tools=[]
malformed.processExitedAfterStartupFailure=true
malformed.serverLog=["malformed.pid=<pid>","malformed.received=initialize#1","malformed.sentHeader=Content-Length:125x"]
`

- Focused regression result: 
ode scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/agent-bundle-lsp-runtime.test.ts passed 1 file / 15 tests on current head.
- Guard and hygiene result: formatter check, git diff --check HEAD~1..HEAD, and commit autoreview passed on current head with no accepted/actionable findings.
- Observed result: the valid lowercase-header subprocess initializes alidcase and exposes hover/definition/references tools; the malformed Content-Length: 125x subprocess is rejected during startup, returns no sessions or tools, and the process is cleaned up after the startup failure.
